headline: Bank of Israel Holds Interest Rate Unchanged Citing Shekel Weakness
summary: Bank of Israel Governor Amir Yaron confirmed the central bank kept its key interest rate on hold due to shekel depreciation and ongoing inflationary pressures.
why: The Bank of Israel sets monetary policy to manage price stability and exchange rate dynamics in the Israeli economy.

impacts.name: Israeli Shekel
impacts.why: The central bank held borrowing costs steady citing foreign exchange depreciation and persistent inflation.
